stem.text: How will the removal of a reversible non-competitive enzyme inhibitor affect an enzyme-catalysed reaction?

A.text: The $K_\text{m}$ will decrease and the $V_\text{max}$ will increase.

B.text: The $K_\text{m}$ will increase and the $V_\text{max}$ will not change.

C.text: The $K_\text{m}$ will not change and the $V_\text{max}$ will increase.

D.text: The $K_\text{m}$ will not change and the $V_\text{max}$ will not change.
